verified_timing_raw: Quantum states that Fireball EL began mass production in May 1998.
source_1_locator: Form 10-Q product discussion: Fireball EL began mass production in May 1998
source_1_evidence: Quantum's SEC filing identifies the Fireball EL family and states May 1998 mass production; it supplies family-level form-factor/interface/capacity context.
source_2_locator: dated April 28 1998 Fireball EL series report
source_2_evidence: Contemporary PC Watch report identifies the Fireball EL series and reports planned May availability.
contradictions_or_limits: Mass production and planned availability do not establish a dated first commercial shipment. Both sources are tied to manufacturer information.
unresolved_questions: Exact introduction date; first commercial shipment; regional and OEM/distribution availability; per-capacity SKU identity.
verifier_notes: Independent verifier confirms a 1998 manufacturing event but flags whether mass production alone satisfies the cohort rule for human review.

verified_timing_raw: Quantum announced Fireball EX on 1998-06-08; mass production was stated for July 1998.
source_1_locator: dated June 9 report: June 8 announcement and July mass-production shipment
source_1_evidence: Contemporary PC Watch reporting identifies Fireball EX, dates its June 8 announcement, and states July mass-production shipment with capacity/interface context.
source_2_locator: Form 10-Q product discussion: Fireball EX announced in June and began mass production in July
source_2_evidence: Quantum's filing independently corroborates June announcement and July mass production at family level.
contradictions_or_limits: The exact first commercial shipment day and regional channel are not stated; two sources are not independent of Quantum's product claims.
unresolved_questions: First shipment date; OEM/distribution geography; per-capacity SKU identity.
verifier_notes: Independent verifier supports retention based on a dated 1998 new-family announcement plus stated July mass production; does not claim a precise commercial-availability day.

verified_timing_raw: IBM unveiled the Deskstar 25GP on 1998-11-11 and shipped limited numbers to PC makers for Christmas 1998; distributor/reseller availability was stated for Q1 1999.
source_1_evidence: Reuters reporting published by WIRED dates the IBM unveiling, identifies the 25 GB Deskstar 25GP at 5,400 RPM, and distinguishes limited PC-maker shipments from Q1 1999 distributor/reseller availability.
source_2_evidence: IBM News republication provides manufacturer-attributed product context for the contemporaneous Deskstar launch.
contradictions_or_limits: Broad distributor/reseller availability is explicitly not a 1998 event. The exact OEM shipment day and regional scope are unstated.
unresolved_questions: Ordering part number; exact OEM shipment date; geography; whether limited PC-maker shipment meets the cohort commercial-shipment boundary.
verifier_notes: Independent verifier retains the record because a limited 1998 OEM shipment is stated, while preserving later broad-channel availability as Q1 1999 only.
